name: Fellbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Fellbach (two white birds on red).
history: Municipal flag of Fellbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fellbach arms — two birds on red
